[Hayal Oezkan][hayal] has created an MCP[^mcp] server to interface with the 
various APIs[^apis] of the Swiss Federal Spatial Data Infrastructure^[FSDI.]. 
The source code for the server (currently at version 0.4.1) is availabe on 
[GitHub][repo] under the MIT license and requires Python 3.11 or higher.

[`swisstopo-mcp`][repo] gives AI agents access to Swiss geodata through [20 
tools][tools]. Authentication is not needed. Sources listed encompass the 
Swisstopo[^swisstopo] REST[^rest] API (that includes more than 500 geodata 
layers), various service endpoints (for example, elevation and geocoding), the 
federal STAC[^stac] catalog, the ÖREB[^oereb]/RDPPF[^rdppf] cadastre, cantonal 
data via geodienste.ch and – somewhat surprising given the MCP server's name – 
OSM[^osm] via Overpass and the OpenPLZ API.

Using [`swisstopo-mcp`][repo] you can, for example, geocode and reverse-geocode 
address and coordinates, respectively, query elevation values and create 
elevation profiles, find and download geodata, identify features across more 
than 500 federal geodata layers, and much more. The full functionality is 
described [in the Readme][repo]. [`swisstopo-mcp`][repo] is part of Hayal's 
[Swiss Public Data MCP Portfolio][mcp-portfolio].

I think an official geospatial MCP by Swiss authorities is planned (or maybe 
even already in the works?) as part of the national "knowledge infrastructure". 
For now, Hayal's [`swisstopo-mcp`][repo] is the one option to access Swiss 
federal geodata through the Model Context Protocol that I'm aware of.

[hayal]: https://www.linkedin.com/in/hayaloezkan/
[repo]: https://github.com/malkreide/swisstopo-mcp
[tools]: https://github.com/malkreide/swisstopo-mcp#available-tools
[mcp-portfolio]: https://github.com/malkreide#-mcp-server--ki-mit-daten-verbinden

[^mcp]: Model Context Protocol, an open standard (introduced by Anthropic in 
late 2024) that lets AI applications connect to external tools, data sources, 
and services through a common interface.
[^apis]: Application Programming Interfaces.
[^swisstopo]: The Federal Office of Topography of Switzerland.
[^rest]: Representational State Transfer, an architectural style for web APIs 
that uses standard HTTP methods to access and manipulate resources identified 
by URLs.
[^stac]: STAC stands for "SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog", a modern, open 
specification for cataloging spatio-temporal data.
[^oereb]: "Öffentlich-rechtliche Eigentumsbeschränkungen", the German name for 
Switzerland's public-law restrictions on landownership.
[^rdppf]: Restrictions de droit public à la propriété foncière, the French name 
for Switzerland's public-law restrictions on landownership.
[^osm]: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/), a collaborative, 
open-licensed map of the world.
